# 🎛️ NEW: record 7 tracks into your DAW · Graba 7 pistas en tu DAW

**English.** The FM-1 is now an **8-channel USB sound card**: plug it into your computer and record every part on its own track, no drivers.

| Channels | Track |
| --- | --- |
| 1-2 | Stereo master (as before) |
| 3 · 4 · 5 | Synth tracks 1 · 2 · 3 |
| 6 | LITE synth |
| 7 | Drums |

Tracks 3-7 are mono and pre-master (level, pan, mute, INSERT and track filter in; shared reverb / delay / chorus only on the master). Most programs record channels 1-2 by default, so the mix works as always. USB audio runs at 44.1 kHz. MIDI is unchanged (identical to SLOOP).

**Install:** download `Kitten-Synths-instalador-2.8-kitten.zip`, unzip it, run `servir.py` (Python 3, Chrome or Edge), press Install. Afterwards unplug and plug in the FM-1 once so the computer sees the 8 channels. Back up first. Manual: https://github.com/BlackKittenDevices/Kitten-Synths/blob/main/MANUAL.en.md#usb-audio

---

**Español.** El FM-1 ahora es una **placa de sonido USB de 8 canales**: enchufalo a la compu y grabá cada parte en su propia pista, sin drivers.

| Canales | Pista |
| --- | --- |
| 1-2 | Master estéreo (como siempre) |
| 3 · 4 · 5 | Sintes 1 · 2 · 3 |
| 6 | Sinte LITE |
| 7 | Batería |

Las pistas 3-7 van en mono y pre-master (con nivel, paneo, mute, INSERT y filtro de pista; la reverb, el delay y el chorus compartidos quedan en el master). Casi todos los programas graban 1-2 por defecto, así que la mezcla funciona como siempre. El audio USB va a 44,1 kHz. El MIDI no cambia (idéntico a SLOOP).

**Instalar:** bajá `Kitten-Synths-instalador-2.8-kitten.zip`, descomprimilo, abrí `servir.py` (Python 3, Chrome o Edge) y apretá Instalar. Después desenchufá y enchufá el FM-1 una vez para que la compu vea los 8 canales. Hacé backup antes. Manual: https://github.com/BlackKittenDevices/Kitten-Synths/blob/main/MANUAL.md#audio-usb

Also / además: MUUG (Minimoog-style, 100 sounds), a fourth LITE synth, 37 drum kits, 64-step sequencer, songs, 27 punch-in effects. Based on SLOOP 2.8 · GPL-3.0 · identity `FM-1_969`.
